research_rationale:
EO 13225 (signed 2001-09-28; 66 FR 50291, Federal Register of 2001-10-03, FR Doc. 01-24917) was read in full in the held Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_13225.txt. Section 1 continues fourteen listed advisory committees until September 30, 2003, section 2 assigns the President's functions under the Federal Advisory Committee Act for them to the department heads named, section 3 revokes five committee-establishing orders or sections, section 4 supersedes sections 1 through 4 of EO 13138, and section 5 makes the order effective September 30, 2001. The continuance and the delegation end by their own terms on 2003-09-30 (inclusive reading; the exclusive reading ends them when that day began); the revocations and the supersession were executed on the effective date 2001-09-30. The whole-order end is therefore 2003-09-30. EO 13316 (signed 2003-09-17; 68 FR 55255, Federal Register of 2003-09-23), section 4, states that EO 13225 is superseded and section 6 makes it effective on the same day, September 30, 2003; it is recorded as a later event on the clauses it reaches. The held EO 13316 text was read in full. The held text is the machine-extracted text layer of the official Federal Register PDF; the PDF page images are not held, so identity (printed number, title, signing date and FR Doc. number) was checked on the text layer against the census register row.

savings.reason: The revocations in section 3 and the supersession in section 4 were completed on the effective date; the revoked orders stay revoked and sections 1 through 4 of EO 13138 stay superseded as accrued effects, and they do not keep EO 13225 operative. Committee actions taken while the committees were continued are accrued acts. No savings clause for EO 13225 appears in EO 13316.
